director.name: 艾维·莫格拉比 Avi Mograbi

introduction: 莫葛洛比和阿隆与来自非洲寻求庇护的人们在内盖夫沙漠中间的一座拘留中心见面，这些人被以色列政府囚禁在这里。是什么让大家舍弃所有去到未知的世界？为什么难民之地以色列不接受那些被流放的人，被卷入战争的人，种族灭绝的人还有被迫害的人？和寻求庇护的人一起工作的以色列人是否能理解难民的难处呢？他们集体的无意识能否被唤醒？Avi Mograbi and Chen Alon meet African asylum-seekers in a detention facility in the middle of the Negev desert where they are confined by the state of Israel. What leads men and women to leave everything behind and go towards the unknown? Why does Israel, land of the refugees, refuse to take into consideration the situation of the exiled, thrown onto the roads by war, genocide and persecution? Can the Israelis working with the asylum seekers put themselves in the refugee's shoes? Can their collective unconscious be conjured up?
